Class Timestamp

java.lang.Object
parking.Timestamp
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Timestamp>
public class Timestamp extends Object implements Comparable<Timestamp>
Timestamp class that represents the date and time of a parking activity. The time uses a 24-hour format with an hour and a minute.

    • Timestamp

      public Timestamp(String date, String time)
      Create a timestamp from a date string and a time string. The time string must be in the format hh:mm.
      Parameters:
      date - the date in the format yyyy-mm-dd.
      time - the time in the format hh:mm.

    • Timestamp

      minute - the minute of the timestamp, from 0 to 59.

      public int compareTo(Timestamp timestamp)
      Compare this timestamp with another timestamp in chronological order.
      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<Timestamp>
      Parameters:
      timestamp - the timestamp to compare with.
